# Rust 2.6.4 compatibility corpus

This directory is the versioned oracle for Go/Rust compatibility. It is
generated by the Rust 2.6.4 oracle at `official-release` / `8428a89d` with
`rust-toolchain 1.95` and consumed by Go golden-vector tests.

## Layout

- `packet/` — `PeerManagerHeader` (16B LE), packet types, flags, `forward_counter`, compressed payloads, foreign-network envelopes, malformed headers, max-frame boundaries.
- `handshake/` — legacy `HandshakeRequest` protobuf vectors, wrong-secret / wrong-network rejection cases.
- `noise/` — `Noise_XX_25519_ChaChaPoly_SHA256` msg1 (plaintext) / msg2+msg3 (encrypted) vectors, prologue `easytier-peerconn-noise`, root-key / epoch / network-secret proofs, X25519 key encoding.
- `secure/` — `ciphertext || tag[16] || nonce[12]` with `epoch||seq`, AES-128/AES-256/ChaCha20, replay window, epoch rotation.
- `config/` — TOML fixtures covering defaults, validation, normalization, `${VAR}` / `${VAR:-default}`, canonical dumps.
- `rpc/` — `RpcDescriptor` field numbers, fragment envelopes, zstd negotiation, error/trace encoding, UDP budget.
- `route/` — 3-node and multi-path graphs, latency-first and manual-route cases.

## Generation

```bash
# Preferred: Rust helper (when available)
cargo run --locked -p easytier --bin gen-fixtures

# Fallback wrapper for local reproduction without a local 1.95 toolchain
./go/testdata/compat/gen.sh

# Verify
git status -- go/testdata/compat
go test -run TestGoldenVectors ./go/...
```

CI job `fixture-corpus` in `.github/workflows/interop.yml` generates the corpus
and fails if `go/testdata/compat` has uncommitted diffs without a migration
record in `docs/GO_REWRITE_SE.md` §11. See `docs/GO_REWRITE_TODOLIST.md` §7 for
the full interop matrix and gates (`FND-04` / `VAL-02`).
